reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), events_eur AS (
  -- one row per subscription event, in euros
  SELECT e.event_type, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT m.month_start,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date < m.month_start THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS opening_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'new' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS new_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'expansion' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'reactivation' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS reactivation_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'contraction' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'churn' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS churn_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(x.mrr_eur), 2) AS closing_mrr
FROM months m
JOIN events_eur x ON x.event_date < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY m.month_start

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), events_eur AS (
  -- one row per subscription event, in euros
  SELECT e.event_type, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
), opening AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT m.month_start, SUM(x.mrr_eur) AS opening_mrr
  FROM months m
  JOIN events_eur x ON x.event_date < m.month_start
  GROUP BY m.month_start
), moves AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with a movement
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'new' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'expansion' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'reactivation' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_mrr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'contraction' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_mrr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'churn' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr
  FROM events_eur
  WHERE event_type <> 'opening' AND event_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT o.month_start, ROUND(o.opening_mrr, 2) AS opening_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.new_mrr, 0), 2) AS new_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.expansion_mrr, 0), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.reactivation_mrr, 0), 2) AS reactivation_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.contraction_mrr, 0), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.churn_mrr, 0), 2) AS churn_mrr,
  ROUND(o.opening_mrr + COALESCE(v.new_mrr + v.expansion_mrr + v.reactivation_mrr + v.contraction_mrr + v.churn_mrr, 0), 2) AS closing_mrr
FROM opening o
LEFT JOIN moves v ON v.month_start = o.month_start

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_type, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS d
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
), m AS (
  SELECT CAST(x AS DATE) AS ms, CAST(x + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS me
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS g(x)
)
SELECT m.ms AS month_start,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_date < m.ms), 0), 2) AS opening_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'new' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS new_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'expansion' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'reactivation' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS reactivation_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'contraction' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS churn_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS closing_mrr
FROM m CROSS JOIN ev
GROUP BY m.ms, m.me
